data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Dolat lies in its connection to Lord Vishnu, who represents wealth in Hindu mythology but also symbolizes Ananta, the infinite, and serves as a reminder of the true nature of wealth. The name is a reminder that true wealth comes from within, and the blessings of the divine can bring both material prosperity and spiritual growth.
